title: Multi Year Medi-Cal Dental Measures Data by County and Age, Calendar Year 2013 to 2024
publisher: California Department of Health Care Services (CHHS Open Data Portal)
measures: Overall utilization of dental services (1 year): Medi-Cal members continuously enrolled in Dental Managed Care or dental Fee-for-Service with at least one dental service or Safety Net Clinic dental encounter. LA County CY 2024 summed across age bands by us: 39.5% all ages (1,379,973 of 3,495,987); 58.0% ages 0–20; 30.2% ages 21+.
limitations: Denominator is continuously enrolled members only; county level; age-band sums are our arithmetic; utilization is not demand for any one practice. Date shown is the dataset metadata-modified date.

title: MediCal Dental FFS Provider Listing
publisher: California Department of Health Care Services (CHHS Open Data Portal)
dataYear: Point in time, layer last edited 2025-09-18
geography: California (queried by billing city in Los Angeles County)
measures: Fee-for-Service Medi-Cal Dental providers and Safety Net Clinics with provider-reported language; we counted distinct NPIs by listed language for billing cities Los Angeles, Long Beach, Pasadena and Glendale.
limitations: Excludes Dental Managed Care providers; billing city is not necessarily the service location; rows are provider/language records, not offices; provider-reported languages may be incomplete.

title: About LA County
measures: County established 1850; 4,084 square miles; nearly 10 million residents (about 27% of California's population); grown from 76 to 88 cities
limitations: County overview page; population wording is approximate.

title: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
publisher: State of California Department of Justice, Office of the Attorney General
measures: Which for-profit businesses the CCPA applies to (revenue, 100,000+ consumers/households, 50%+ revenue from selling data); exemption of certain medical information; right to opt out of sale/sharing including via a global privacy control that covered businesses must honor
limitations: Consumer-facing summary, not legal advice; the revenue figure shown on this page ($25 million) predates the CPPA's adjusted threshold. Published date is the page's 'Updated on' date.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
measures: CCPA thresholds including gross annual revenue of $26.625 million or more (effective January 1, 2025); obligations of service providers and contractors; nonprofits generally not covered
limitations: Agency FAQ, not legal advice; thresholds adjust periodically.

title: AB 925 (2015–16), as introduced: Legislative Counsel's Digest (Penal Code section 632)
measures: Digest summary of then-existing Penal Code 632: crime to eavesdrop on or record a confidential communication without the consent of all parties, including by telephone; such evidence inadmissible
limitations: A 2015 bill digest describing the law at that time, not the current statute text; the current code page could not be retrieved (bot challenge). Confirm with counsel.
